basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee JRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Space Science & Technology at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee is filling one JRF position in the Dept. of Space (Bengaluru) sponsored project "Investigation of Venusian Atmospheric Waves and Their Role in Wave-Mean Flow Interactions Using Remote Sensing Techniques". The position carries Rs. 37000 + HRA for 2 years. Only Indian nationals may apply, with a Post Graduate Degree in Physics/Space Physics/Atmospheric Science or related subjects, selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or JEST. The application goes through a Google form, and the last date is 25 December 2026, 1

how_to_apply: Open the Google form link given in the notice (see Important Links below).
Submit the application through the link by 25 December 2026, 11:59 PM.
Attach the documents named in the notice: CV, degree certificates and experience certificates.
Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification.
The notice gives the Principal Investigator's email as [email protected] and describes the last date as the date for the application to be submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Originals of degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) must be brought at the time of interview for verification. Only Indian nationals may apply.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Investigation of Venusian Atmospheric Waves and Their Role in Wave-Mean Flow Interactions Using Remote Sensing Techniques
Centre for Space Science & Technology, IIT Roorkee

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. The essential qualification for the JRF post is a Post Graduate Degree in Physics/Space Physics/Atmospheric Science or related subjects, selected through any of the national level tests named in the notice. Candidates must make sure, before appearing for the interview, that they are eligible for the position they apply for. For discipline-specific eligibility, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Physics/Space Physics/Atmospheric Science or related subjects, selected through CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship)/Ph.D. Only, GATE or JEST
rows.desirable: Working knowledge of MATLAB or Python programming

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 37000 + HRA. The duration of the position is 2 years. The notice states that the selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission. If selected, the candidate will join the position as soon as possible.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee JRF Job Description
content_sections.text: Analyse archival data obtained from instruments onboard previous planetary missions to Venus. Interpret the scientific findings. Prepare research manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals. Present the results at scientific conferences and meetings.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee JRF
content_sections.text: Open the Google form link given in the notice (see Important Links below). Submit the application through the link by 25 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Attach the documents named in the notice: CV, degree certificates and experience certificates. Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification. The notice gives the Principal Investigator's email as [email protected] and describes the last date as the date for the application to be submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates who apply through the form appear for an interview. The notice does not print an interview date or venue. On equal qualifications and experience, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Originals of degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) must be brought at the time of interview for verification. Only Indian nationals may apply.
